# Temple Scroll Column 11 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 11 | **Condition:** heavily damaged / fragmentary

---

**11:1** [...] On the first day of the seventh month, you shall hold a sacred assembly [...]

**11:2** [...] You shall do no laborious work [...]

**11:3** [...] It shall be for you a day of remembrance marked by trumpet blasts [...]

**11:4** [...] a memorial before Me [...]

**11:5** [...] And you shall offer a burnt offering, a fire offering of pleasing aroma to the LORD [...]

**11:6** [...] one young bull from the herd, one ram [...]

**11:7** [...] seven yearling lambs without blemish [...]

**11:8** [...] with their grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths of an ephah for the bull [...]

**11:9** [...] two-tenths of an ephah for the ram [...]

**11:10** [...] and one-tenth of an ephah for each of the seven lambs [...]

**11:11** [...] and one male goat as a sin offering, to make atonement on your behalf [...]

**11:12** [...] in addition to the burnt offering of the new moon and its grain offering [...]

**11:13** [...] and the perpetual burnt offering with its grain offering, and their drink offerings [...]

**11:14** [...] according to their prescribed measure — a fire offering of pleasing aroma to the LORD [...]

**11:15** [...] This shall be a perpetual statute throughout your generations [...]

**11:16** [...] in all your dwelling places [...]

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering of the heavily damaged Column 11. The three translators largely agreed on substance given the strong parallels to Numbers 29:1-6. LOGOS phrasing adopted as base for its balance of accuracy and clarity. EMET's "sons of a year" modernized to "yearling" per LOGOS/PNEUMA agreement. PNEUMA's "lasting requirement" replaced with "perpetual statute" to preserve legal register. "On your behalf" (LOGOS) preferred over "upon you" (EMET) for the atonement formula. Five disagreements logged.*
